kc_source: FAO-56 T12 rice Kc 1.05/1.20/0.90-0.60; used 0.90 (upper end; FAO-56 gives no rule for picking within the range). T11 30/30/60/30 = 150 d, Dec/May, Tropics. Percolation 4 mm/d for heavy clay from FAO Irrigation Water Management Training Manual 3 s4.3 (NOT FAO-56; FAO-56 does not model paddy water balance). Manual 3's 200 mm saturation and 100 mm water layer are NOT included, so rice demand is understated. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

FAO-56 T12 'Green Gram and Cowpeas' Kc 0.4 (legume group value; no crop-specific Kc_ini printed)/1.05/0.60-0.35; used 0.35 per T12 note 6 = harvested dry, the normal case for mungbean as a pulse. T11 20/30/30/20 = 110 d, March, Mediterranean - the ONLY variant, no tropical one. 'Green gram' = Vigna radiata is standard synonymy, not stated by FAO-56. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

FAO-56 T12 'Egg Plant' Kc 0.6 (Solanaceae group value; no crop-specific Kc_ini printed)/1.05/0.90. T11 30/40/40/20 = 130 d, October, Arid Region. No tropical variant. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).

FAO-56 T12 tomato Kc 0.6 (Solanaceae group value)/1.15/0.70-0.90; used 0.90 (upper end). T11 30/40/40/25 = 135 d, January, Arid Region. All five T11 tomato variants are Arid/California/Mediterranean; none tropical. Kc NOT climate-adjusted (Eq. 62/65).
